title: About Me
description: Thank you for visiting my portfolio website!

My name is Sze Man Chang, and you can call me Celia 😊 I am a UI/UX and graphic designer with a digital marketing background. I love creating digital experiences that are both user-friendly and visually appealing. I believe in the power of design to make ideas come to life and drive real results. Let's work together to create designs that engage, inform, and inspire.
